metadata.Applies To Forms: MM-CP-0010, MM-CP-1030, MM-CP-E101, MM-CP-E205, MM-CP-E310, MM-CP-E415, MM-CP-FL-01

rows: MM-CP-0010, MM-CP-1030, MM-CP-E101, MM-CP-E205, MM-CP-E310, MM-CP-E415, MM-CP-FL-01

clauses.text: 1.1 The insured is required by MM-CP-0010 Section E.3(b) to report loss within 72 hours of becoming aware of it; in Florida, MM-CP-FL-01 Section 5.3 extends this period to 14 days. Late notice must not be used to deny a claim unless the delay prejudiced our investigation.
clauses.full_text: 1.1 The insured is required by MM-CP-0010 Section E.3(b) to report loss within 72 hours of becoming aware of it; in Florida, MM-CP-FL-01 Section 5.3 extends this period to 14 days. Late notice must not be used to deny a claim unless the delay prejudiced our investigation.

exceptions.text: unless the delay prejudiced our investigation.

clauses.text: 1.2 The adjuster must acknowledge receipt of every claim in writing within 14 calendar days in Florida and within 15 business days in Texas, per the applicable state claims-handling requirements referenced in Filings MM-FL-2025-0142 and MM-TX-2025-0098.
clauses.full_text: 1.2 The adjuster must acknowledge receipt of every claim in writing within 14 calendar days in Florida and within 15 business days in Texas, per the applicable state claims-handling requirements referenced in Filings MM-FL-2025-0142 and MM-TX-2025-0098.

clauses.text: 1.3 At FNOL the adjuster must record: policy number, form edition of MM-CP-0010 in force, all attached endorsements, date of loss, cause of loss, and the scheduled location involved.
clauses.full_text: 1.3 At FNOL the adjuster must record: policy number, form edition of MM-CP-0010 in force, all attached endorsements, date of loss, cause of loss, and the scheduled location involved.

clauses.text: 2.1 The adjuster must verify that the form edition and endorsements on the policy match the editions approved in the applicable State Filing before issuing any coverage position.
clauses.full_text: 2.1 The adjuster must verify that the form edition and endorsements on the policy match the editions approved in the applicable State Filing before issuing any coverage position.

clauses.text: 2.2 For any loss involving water, the adjuster must determine whether the cause of loss is Flood as excluded by EXCL-FLD in MM-CP-1030 Section B.1.g, and then check whether MM-CP-E101 is attached and whether the damaged premises is a scheduled location under that endorsement.
clauses.full_text: 2.2 For any loss involving water, the adjuster must determine whether the cause of loss is Flood as excluded by EXCL-FLD in MM-CP-1030 Section B.1.g, and then check whether MM-CP-E101 is attached and whether the damaged premises is a scheduled location under that endorsement.

clauses.text: 2.3 If MM-CP-E101 is attached and the premises is a scheduled location, Flood damage to COV-A and COV-B is covered up to the Flood Sublimit of $250,000 subject to the 5% Flood Deductible; COV-D is not covered unless the Schedule shows a COV-D Flood Sublimit.
clauses.full_text: 2.3 If MM-CP-E101 is attached and the premises is a scheduled location, Flood damage to COV-A and COV-B is covered up to the Flood Sublimit of $250,000 subject to the 5% Flood Deductible; COV-D is not covered unless the Schedule shows a COV-D Flood Sublimit.

exceptions.text: unless the Schedule shows a COV-D Flood Sublimit.

clauses.text: 2.4 If MM-CP-E101 is not attached, or the premises is not a scheduled location, Flood damage is not covered and a reservation of rights letter must be issued within 10 business days.
clauses.full_text: 2.4 If MM-CP-E101 is not attached, or the premises is not a scheduled location, Flood damage is not covered and a reservation of rights letter must be issued within 10 business days.

rows: Covered only if E101 attached and location scheduled
Covered up to $100,000 if E205 attached
Not covered if insured knew of impairment and did not notify

clauses.text: 3.1 An adjuster must not set a reserve or issue a payment above his or her authority.
clauses.full_text: 3.1 An adjuster must not set a reserve or issue a payment above his or her authority.

clauses.text: 3.2 Initial reserves must be set within 5 business days of FNOL and reviewed every 30 days.
clauses.full_text: 3.2 Initial reserves must be set within 5 business days of FNOL and reviewed every 30 days.

sections.title: SECTION 4 - PROOF OF LOSS AND PAYMENT

clauses.section_title: SECTION 4 - PROOF OF LOSS AND PAYMENT
clauses.text: 4.1 Under MM-CP-0010 Section E.3(d) the insured must submit a signed, sworn proof of loss within 60 days of our request. The adjuster may extend this period in writing.
clauses.full_text: 4.1 Under MM-CP-0010 Section E.3(d) the insured must submit a signed, sworn proof of loss within 60 days of our request. The adjuster may extend this period in writing.

clauses.section_title: SECTION 4 - PROOF OF LOSS AND PAYMENT
clauses.text: 4.2 Under Section E.4 we must state our coverage position within 30 days of receiving the proof of loss and pay undisputed amounts within 30 days.
clauses.full_text: 4.2 Under Section E.4 we must state our coverage position within 30 days of receiving the proof of loss and pay undisputed amounts within 30 days.

clauses.section_title: SECTION 4 - PROOF OF LOSS AND PAYMENT
clauses.text: 4.3 When a percentage deductible applies under MM-CP-E310 or MM-CP-E101, the adjuster must document the Limit of Insurance used to calculate the deductible and the resulting dollar amount.
clauses.full_text: 4.3 When a percentage deductible applies under MM-CP-E310 or MM-CP-E101, the adjuster must document the Limit of Insurance used to calculate the deductible and the resulting dollar amount.

clauses.text: 5.1 For any theft, vandalism, sprinkler leakage or water damage claim the adjuster must determine whether the building was vacant for more than 60 consecutive days before the loss (MM-CP-0010 Section E.5). If so, the loss is not covered.
clauses.full_text: 5.1 For any theft, vandalism, sprinkler leakage or water damage claim the adjuster must determine whether the building was vacant for more than 60 consecutive days before the loss (MM-CP-0010 Section E.5). If so, the loss is not covered.

clauses.text: 5.2 For fire losses at premises with MM-CP-E415, the adjuster must obtain evidence that the scheduled protective safeguards were operational, or that any impairment was reported to us within 48 hours.
clauses.full_text: 5.2 For fire losses at premises with MM-CP-E415, the adjuster must obtain evidence that the scheduled protective safeguards were operational, or that any impairment was reported to us within 48 hours.

clauses.text: 6.1 The adjuster must evaluate subrogation potential on every claim above $10,000 and must preserve evidence.
clauses.full_text: 6.1 The adjuster must evaluate subrogation potential on every claim above $10,000 and must preserve evidence.

clauses.text: 6.2 Salvage must be offered for sale within 30 days of payment where the recovery is expected to exceed $2,500.
clauses.full_text: 6.2 Salvage must be offered for sale within 30 days of payment where the recovery is expected to exceed $2,500.
